record.one_liner: BigCommerce offers a suite of REST and GraphQL APIs using OAuth and JWT authentication to manage store data, authenticate customers, and build apps.

auth_methods.quote: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce’s REST APIs: store-level credentials, app-level credentials, and account-level credentials.

api_type.quote: BigCommerce offers a suite of APIs that let you manage store data, sign customers in, make client-side queries for product information, and write apps that integrate third-party services into store operations.

api_breadth.quote: BigCommerce has several APIs that let you manage store data, authenticate customers, make client-side queries for product information, and more.
